name: restrained
_note: Native block program (Phase 3 §5d). TODO: Speed becomes 0 and cannot benefit from any bonus to speed (pending movement system). Attack disadvantage (self), attack advantage (attackers), and disadvantage on DEX saving throws are implemented. The rider is holder-agnostic: it is installed on the conditioned entity, so it works whether restrained is applied to a target or to the caster itself.
